elements.content: Grammar focus: Syntactic Fronting & Passive Reporting.

Core Rule: Combine a fronted spatial/temporal adverbial with an impersonal passive reporting clause: Adverbial + Passive Reporting Verb + Clause .

In regional intelligence — it is reported that: In regional intelligence , it is reported that troop movements have ceased.
Across eastern sectors — disruptions were observed: Across eastern sectors , widespread power disruptions were observed.
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which sentence correctly combines fronting with passive reporting?
options: In strategic briefings, it was emphasized that security remains paramount.
In strategic briefings, emphasized that security remains paramount.

elements.content: 2. Why combine fronting with passive reporting in geopolitical briefs?
options: To establish thematic location/context first, followed by an objective report
